questions: Which federal tax depletion methods and eligibility limits are described for oil and gas?
inspected_summary: Chapter 9 describes cost and percentage depletion. For oil/gas wells it says percentage depletion is generally limited to independent producers or royalty owners (with stated exceptions) and describes a 15% rate subject to production limits and retailer/refiner restrictions. The 2025 IRS partner K-1 instructions directly link this 2022 edition. Tax eligibility and deduction are separate from GAAP reserve-based depletion.

publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission; official 2025 CFR via GovInfo

questions: How do successful-efforts and full-cost methods differ for exploration/development, production, country cost centers, amortization, ceiling and abandonment?
inspected_summary: Section (b) routes successful-efforts reporting to ASC 932. Section (c) requires full cost across the reporting entity and subsidiaries with country-by-country cost centers, prescribed capitalized acquisition/exploration/development cost categories, production-cost expense, amortization/ceiling limits, and specific conveyance/abandonment accounting. It applies to the SEC registrant scope and its rule-defined conditions; it is not universal private-company GAAP instruction.
